Against `bun run dispatch:local`: `cd packages/dispatch && DISPATCH_E2E_REUSE_SERVERS=1 DATABASE_URL='postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:55433/dispatch_tester?sslmode=disable' bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --project=firefox --project=iphone e2e/picture-link-click.e2e.ts` → chromium passed, iphone passed, firefox failed: expect(page).toHaveURL('/issues/CORE-1/artifacts/notes-md') received 'http://127.0.0.1:8777/issues/CORE-1/spec'. Mechanism (Playwright Firefox 155, capture-phase probe on a 20-paragraph spec): mousedown target=A at y=397; after mousedown the DOM selection is a Caret in the document's first text ('Picture check', the editor's own selection written back by ProseMirror's focus handler once the editing host took focus — Firefox does not focus a link on mousedown, and stopEvent keeps ProseMirror's own mousedown handling out) and the page scrolled (scrollY 1956 → 342); mouseup target=IMG (what is now under the pointer); click target=DIV, so ProofDocument's onClick (`closest('a')`) finds nothing and the browser's default does not follow a link inside an editable host. Controls: the caret first placed in the paragraph beside the link → the click navigates in-app (marker kept); a prose link mark in the same document → click target A, navigates; Chromium → activeElement A, navigates. The selection fix has no browser-observable test (the implementer could not place a DOM selection in the link by gesture; a programmatic selection shows the editor acting at the link, which pins ProseMirror's default rather than this code). The red test runs on chromium and iphone too and passes there, so it is a cross-engine lock, not a Firefox-only row.
notes: Observed, not a failure: in the read-only version view a click on the fallback link is taken by the editor library's markdownLinkClickPlugin (proof-sdk editor/plugins/markdown-link-click.ts via handleDOMEvents.click, which stopEvent does not gate — prosemirror-view registers handleDOMEvents listeners through runCustomHandler without eventBelongsToView): it prevents the default and opens the artifact page in a new tab (window.open(href, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer'); a targetcreated for /issues/CORE-8/artifacts/notes-md observed in Chromium). The plan's 'the read-only version view follows href by the browser's own navigation' is not what happens; the page is reached.

Observed, pre-existing rule: after a drag-drop ProseMirror leaves a non-collapsed selection, so the next click on the moved link goes through the browser's default (a full load to the right page) by ProofDocument.tsx:770-773's step-aside; the e2e drag row asserts the URL only, which holds either way.
